items.title: Approve the Minutes of the May 21, 2024 Meeting
Community Advisory Committee Report Board Meeting Notice
Adopt the 2023 Prop L 5-Year Prioritization Programs (5YPPs) for Mission Bay Ferry Landing and Transformative Freeway and Major Street Projects
Allocate $46,724,637 in Prop L Funds and $2,786,000 in Prop AA Funds, with Conditions
Adopt the Proposed Fiscal Year 2024/25 Annual Budget and Work Program
Approve Revised Administrative Code; Debt and Fiscal Policies; and Ratify the Investment Policy
